title: the-base-tool-defines-the-testing-mark-once
intention: The base tool defines the testing mark exactly once — the process mark (CAIRN_TESTER_ORIGIN read as {'kind': 'test', 'run': id}) and the name mark (a name starting 'testing-') — in a public module cairn.tools.base.origin, and every DiagnosticBase emission born under the process mark carries it as its origin.
why: Test against live, marked as testing (ruled 2026-09-28, extended 2026-10-04): the live system is the test surface; every test output carries a testing mark so it can be thrown away; everyone not testing tolerates and ignores testing artifacts. Law 4: until the mark has one definition and a stamp, every site that spells 'testing-' is policy. 71d1bbfa98b0 is split per component under RULE 1 (encapsulation, Akien 2026-10-01): every component talks to another only through its public interface; a ticket's build lives inside its own component and its proofs and hollow measure only that component; this is its first child, the definition every sibling imports.
how: New cairn/tools/base/origin.py: ENV='CAIRN_TESTER_ORIGIN', TESTING_PREFIX='testing-', test_origin() -> {'kind':'test','run':id} or None (unset or empty), is_testing_name(name) -> bool (str starting 'testing-'); stdlib only (os). cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py: import test_origin; DiagnosticBase.emit adds record['origin'] = test_origin() when it is not None (raise_trouble rides emit, so a trouble a proof raises carries it too). cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json: public_interface gains 'cairn.tools.base.origin' through the artifact door, a one-line textual insert. The exact code diff rides this ticket's build_patch field. One new proof, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_origin_marks_what_a_test_bore.py, already written red.
falsifier: GREEN when cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_origin_marks_what_a_test_bore.py passes all four teeth: (1) test_origin() returns {'kind':'test','run':id} with CAIRN_TESTER_ORIGIN=id and None when unset or empty; (2) is_testing_name is True for 'testing-…' and False for a live id, '', None, 7 and 'a-testing-name'; (3) a held DiagnosticBase emits origin under the env and no origin key without it; (4) cairn.tools.base.origin is in cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json public_interface; and test_diagnostic.py, test_device_logs_unwired.py, test_raise_trouble.py stay green. RED if any fails. WRONG INTENT if the mark needs per-record judgement the env cannot carry (then the stamp belongs at each door, not in the base).
watchme: none, because the stamp's consumers are the sibling children of 71d1bbfa98b0 (the tester's debris census reads origin), and that census is the watch
children: none, because the change is one module, one emit line and one charter line plus its one proof, already on disk at cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_origin_marks_what_a_test_bore.py

+"""origin — the one definition of the testing mark (ticket be4a7b3c7caa, child 1 of 71d1bbfa98b0).
+
+Test against live, marked as testing (Akien, ruled 2026-09-28, extended 2026-10-04): the live
+system is the test surface, and everything a test puts on it carries a mark so it can be thrown
+away. The mark has two faces and this module is the only place either is spelled:
+
+  - the PROCESS mark: the tester sets ``CAIRN_TESTER_ORIGIN=<run id>`` in a proof's environment
+    (env var naming: CAIRN_<COMPONENT>_<NAME>). ``test_origin()`` reads it as
+    ``{"kind": "test", "run": <id>}``, the stamp an emission born under it carries; unset or
+    empty, it is ``None`` and nothing is stamped.
+  - the NAME mark: a device id, folder or addressee a test puts on the live bus starts
+    ``testing-``. ``is_testing_name()`` says so, so a consumer can tolerate and ignore it.
+
+Stdlib only (``os``): it sits at the base floor beside ``address``, imported by DiagnosticBase.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+ENV = "CAIRN_TESTER_ORIGIN"
+TESTING_PREFIX = "testing-"
+
+
+def test_origin() -> dict | None:
+    """The stamp for anything born in this process: ``{"kind": "test", "run": id}``, or None."""
+    run = os.environ.get(ENV, "")
+    return {"kind": "test", "run": run} if run else None
+
+
+def is_testing_name(name) -> bool:
+    """True iff ``name`` is a string carrying the testing mark at its start."""
+    return isinstance(name, str) and name.startswith(TESTING_PREFIX)
